node.title: Split parameter-cone pair lines have a two-label weighted tuple resource
node.statement: For a fixed dimension-s polynomial carrier V, s>=3, independent functionals ell1,ell2 and affine offsets, assume each chosen low pair difference satisfies ell1(a)=0,ell2(a)=ell1(b),ell2(b)=0, raw1..T<=d, and V evaluations are nonzero on selected joint cores. At most K-s+2 original labels have a moving-carrier zero on their cores. For the rest, sum raw<=floor(2*(n)_s/(s*(m-T)*product_(j=1)^(s-2)(d-T+j))). Inserting every defect gives invertible restricted incidence Jacobians; each fixed common tuple meets a noncontained affine-line section of w=gamma*t in at most two points. No independent moving-carrier normalization or global budget is summed. Full-source funding and noncontained pair lines belong to the consumer.
